component.name: UniNote
component.summary: Academic Freehand Note-Taking and Vector PDF Annotation Suite for Linux

description.p: UniNote is a native, high-performance Linux desktop application engineered specifically for university STEM lectures, mathematical derivations, academic research, and engineering design. Built from the ground up in Rust, GTK 4, Libadwaita, and Cairo.

ul.li: 120Hz sub-millisecond vector inking engine with Catmull-Rom splines and cubic Bézier curves
Metric A4 notebooks and unbounded infinite whiteboard with procedural zoom grid
Non-destructive PDF slide import and typographic vector multi-page export
Spatial lasso and marquee selection with atomic undo/redo history
Hardware-calibrated palm rejection and digitizer stylus handling for MPP and Wacom

screenshot.caption: Academic Dashboard and recent notes hub
A4 notebook view with inking island and vector stroke rendering
Infinite whiteboard canvas with dynamic grid and lasso selection

description.p: Release v0.5.3: Armonizzazione estetica globale UI/UX (Material You M3 e Libadwaita). Barra superiore con pulsanti e icone coerenti ad altezza 36px e raggio 10px, barra di ricerca centrata, dialogo di creazione con 3 card di anteprima sfondi, finestra Impostazioni con larghezza minima 840px senza troncamenti nei titoli delle schede, widget interattivo di calibrazione pressione stilo, contrasto maniglie di selezione WCAG AA e rimozione completa delle cartelle cloud a favore dell'approccio locale offline-first.

Release v0.5.2: nuovo strumento Puntatore Laser volatile con scia al plasma e spessore regolabile, correzione della classificazione dei tratti brevi con penne a calibro ultra-fine (BUG-002). Include inoltre il dialogo Cloud senza credenziali (le cartelle sono locali e sincronizzate dal client desktop) e le azioni del launcher "Nuovo Quaderno A4" e "Nuova Lavagna Infinita" ora operative.

Release v0.5.0: Ottimizzazioni prestazionali chiave con isolamento del generatore sintetico di dataset dal binario di release (PERF-001), caricamento batch ad alta efficienza degli elementi del documento da database SQLite con abbattimento dei round-trip SQL (PERF-002), unificazione completa dei dialoghi modali e consolidamento dell'architettura.

Release v0.4.22: Risoluzione del problema di apertura immediata del documento durante l'avvio del drag per spostarlo (gestione fluida del drag and drop con isolamento click e thumbnail mobile sotto il cursore), e correzione dell'isolamento delle sottocartelle nella dashboard per cui i file spostati in sottocartelle non compaiono erroneamente nella vista principale.

Release v0.4.21: Spostamento file tra cartelle e sottocartelle: nuova azione contestuale "Sposta in..." con selezione gerarchica Adwaita e creazione rapida di sottocartelle, supporto completo a Drag and Drop sulle card delle cartelle e nella sidebar, e apertura contestuale al clic destro sulle card dei documenti.

Release v0.4.20: Coerenza cromatica fedele al tema chiaro/scuro per tutte le copertine dei documenti e delle lavagne nella dashboard. Adattamento automatico contrasto tratti ink con luminanza Rec.709 (i tratti scuri diventano nitidi su fogli scuri e viceversa), coordinamento colori sfondi e rigature, rigenerazione istantanea al cambio tema e corretta sincronizzazione formato documento da disco.

Release v0.4.19: Complete overhaul of folder cards and document covers: full-width folder art banner, clean vector folder geometry without ear artifacts, removal of artificial green dot on whiteboard covers with dynamic bounding-box auto-framing, unified 260px card cover height, and instant cover thumbnail regeneration on save/navigation.

Release v0.4.18: Atomic eraser batch undo/redo transaction grouping, restoring all erased and sliced stroke segments from a single drag motion with a single Ctrl+Z keystroke, and optimized persistence avoiding redundant intermediate disk writes.

Release v0.4.17: Fix eraser indicator stray line artifact via clean path initialization, perfect stroke cut boundaries matching visible eraser diameter without penetration, and pen thickness uncapped below 1.0pt.

Release v0.4.15: Context menu on right-click or long-press for selections and images with Move Up, Move Down, Copy, Duplicate, and Delete actions, atomic z-index reordering with full Undo/Redo symmetry, and touch gesture support.

Release v0.4.14: Sub-Phase 4D Milestones M3 & M4 — Interactive image selection, direct hit testing in z-index order, 8-handle perimeter scaling with opposite pivot preservation, 120Hz smooth translation, atomic delete with full undo/redo, dashboard document thumbnail rendering with image support, and high-resolution vector PDF export with asset rasterization.

Release v0.4.12: Sub-Phase 4D Milestone M2 — System clipboard image pasting via Ctrl+V and paste_image supporting PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF and GDK textures, smart active viewport centering for Notebook and Whiteboard, SQLite hash-addressed asset deduplication, in-memory ImageCacheManager and automatic item selection upon insertion.

Release v0.4.11: Fix multi-page PDF export coordinate shifting for notebooks, adaptive ink contrast projection for light paper printing, isolated alpha group blending for highlighters, and dual Light/Dark PDF export actions.
Release v0.4.9: Robustness fix for per-segment eraser slice engine, fixing index out of bounds panics via Bézier cache realignment, bounds clamping, NaN/Inf guards, and safe point interpolation.

Release v0.4.8: Live 120Hz circular eraser indicator with mode and radius popover, dynamic pen dock slot management with context menu safeguards, extended 10x zoom with procedural micro-grid and 0.25pt ultra-fine caliber, and direct in-app Cloud synchronization (Nextcloud and Google Drive) with isolated storage.

Release v0.4.7: Material 3 settings redesign with a GitHub panel and update check, clipboard selection, folder dashboard and sidebar navigation, affine stroke transformations with fully reversible editing commands, per-segment eraser, interactive AABB resize handles and the new vector brand identity.
Release v0.3.0: official Linux packaging support with Arch Linux (AUR) package, Flathub-compatible Flatpak bundle, desktop integration, and vector iconography.
